nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the balm dissolves makeup and sunscreen without leaving a greasy feeling.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the balm leaves skin soft and hydrated without dryness or tightness, provided it is massaged in and rinsed off thoroughly with warm water.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, breakouts, or eye stinging, with one noting it is one of the only products her skin tolerates.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature/aging skin report improved, softer-looking skin and describe it as a holy grail for their routine.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describing their skin as mature or aging report smoother, better-looking skin and one credits it with looking younger.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the balm leaves skin hydrated, moisturized, and not tight or dry after rinsing; one dry-skin reviewer warns it can leave residue if not rinsed with enough warm water.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report no stripping, itching, or reactions, with several noting other cleansers previously irritated their eyes or skin while this one did not.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers say their skin has cleared up with fewer blemishes since using it, though they describe this as a personal impression rather than a certainty.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer blemishes and no new breakouts since switching to this balm; no reviewer reports it causing breakouts, though one reviewer's general dissatisfaction (poor makeup removal) is unrelated to blemish complaints.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the product removes makeup and sunscreen without leaving a greasy after-feel.

aspects.libelle: Blurs vision if used near eyes
Large jar offers good value and longevity
Leaves skin soft and smooth after rinse

extraits.titre: Didn't remove makeup but DID mess up my contact lenses
extraits.texte: I wanted to like this (so much so that I ordered two of the largest jars offered). But it barely made a dent in the Clinique waterproof mascara (even after desperate rubbing after trying gentle wipes). What if DID do was make a mess of my 30 day contacts so that I have to remove them and soak them after I've washed my face. I was definitely NOT looking to add that extra step, time, or effort to my nightly routine. I will be returning these and I would NOT recommend it for contact lense wearers.

extraits.titre: LOVE this!  Best makeup remover ever!
extraits.texte: This is the best makeup remover I've ever used. It easily removes water resistant full coverage foundation and waterproof makeup, lipstick, etc. After I rub the product around my face (sometimes add a little warm water to the mix), I then run a clean washcloth under warm water to wipe everything off. I have sensitive skin and prone to breakouts with certain products. This product doesn't cause breakouts and my skin feels hydrated and silky smooth when I'm done.

I have very sensitive skin and almost everything makes my face break out but this stuff doesn't. It's so sensitive there is literally 1 moisturizer I can uses that my face doesn't have a reaction to. I leave it in the shower and when I shower at night I use it to remove my makeup and then wash my face. I have been using this stuff for years and nothing compares to it.

extraits.titre: Takes stubborn makeup off and great for oily skin
extraits.texte: I have oily skin and I dislike the feeling of greesiness. This cleasing balm is amazing as it completely dissolves the makeup and sunscreen, while leaving my skin feeling very clean. Does not feel greesy on my skin! This is my second time purchasing a big tub. It lasts a long time.

extraits.titre: They should call this "Melt the day away"...
extraits.texte: All time favorite makeup remover, or "melter" before washing my face. It is not harsh and it loosens up even the strongest finishing spray I've used. It leaves me feeling hydrated and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. I have dry skin and I absolutely love this!

I use this balm as step 2 of my makeup removal process primarily for my face makeup and eyebrows. I use the liquid take the day off for my eyes and lips. I've tried many other brands but went back to this. Solid 10 for my mature skin

I would only recommend this for dry skin. The secret: rub it between your fingers, then massage it thoroughly (not spread it) onto dry skin. Then take it off with a washcloth and A LOT of warm water. If you wipe it off like a cleansing cream, it will leave a lot behind.. Massaging and rinsing left my skin very soft. Love this!
